  ?publicSpace wdt:[property:instance of]*/wdt:[property:subclass of]* wd:[entity:public space] .
  ?publicSpace wdt:[property:contains] ?tableTennisTable .
  ?tableTennisTable wdt:[property:instance of]*/wdt:[property:subclass of]* wd:[entity:table tennis table] .
  ?publicSpace p:[property:coordinate location] ?st .
  ?st ps:[property:coordinate location] ?coord .
  ?coord wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat .
  ?coord wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon .
  SERVICE <http://www.wikidata.org/sparql> {
    bd:sample(?lat) .
    bd:sample(?lon) .
  }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { 
    bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" .
    ?publicSpace rdfs:label ?publicSpaceLabel .
    ?tableTennisTable rdfs:label ?tableTennisTableLabel .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?publicSpace ?publicSpaceLabel ?tableTennisTable ?tableTennisTableLabel
HAVING (SAMPLE(?lat) IS NOT NULL && SAMPLE(?lon) IS NOT NULL)
